g.text: Matched-loss contrasts do not pass the prespecified screening gates

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475467

g.text: Primary endpoint: training loss = 0.25 × initial loss. Each line is one paired seed; diamonds are arithmetic means.
Dashed lines: ±0.01-nat effect floor. Positive B favors nonlinear PB; positive D favors its comparative nonlinear gain.
Four discovery pairs, descriptive only. Failure of the screening rule does not establish equivalence or absence of nonlinearity.
